title: Temporal Diffusion Models for Joint Signal-Channel Estimation under Gaussian and $\alpha$-Stable MIMO Channels
abstract: arXiv:2611.22548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful tools for learning complex data distributions and solving inverse problems. However, most diffusion models rely on the Gaussian distribution, which does not accurately represent heavy-tailed data. In this work, we study diffusion-based reconstruction under Gaussian and symmetric $\alpha$-stable fading channels, while also exploring the benefits of using possible temporal dependence in the channel. We consider two variants: pilot-based channel-only estimation and joint image-channel recovery for MIMO systems. Our approach is based on several standard and score-based diffusion models for both Gaussian and $\alpha$-stable distributions. We refine these models by guiding the reverse diffusion process using the observation likelihood and show how a single trained diffusion model can be reused for the location-scale family of distributions without retraining. translated_title: 高斯与α-稳定MIMO信道下联合信号-信道估计的时序扩散模型
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已成为学习复杂数据分布和求解逆问题的强大工具。然而，大多数扩散模型依赖于高斯分布，而高斯分布并不能准确刻画重尾数据。在本工作中，我们研究了在高斯信道和对称α-稳定衰落信道下基于扩散的重构方法，同时探索了利用信道中可能存在的时间相关性的好处。我们考虑了两种变体：基于导频的纯信道估计，以及面向MIMO系统的图像-信道联合恢复。我们的方法基于多种标准扩散模型和基于分数的扩散模型，以分别适用于高斯分布和α-稳定分布。我们通过使用观测似然来引导反向扩散过程对这些模型进行改进，并展示了单个训练好的扩散模型无需重新训练即可在位置-尺度分布族中复用。在盲MIMO恢复中，将单独的扩散（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种时序扩散模型，在高斯与α-稳定MIMO信道下实现联合信号-信道估计，通过观测似然引导反向扩散过程，并使单个训练好的扩散模型无需重新训练即可复用于位置-尺度分布族。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes temporal diffusion models for joint signal-channel estimation under Gaussian and α-stable MIMO channels, guiding the reverse diffusion process with observation likelihood and enabling a single trained diffusion model to be reused across the location-scale family of distributions without retraining.
